Chapter 349 - 349 Success; Cooperation Plan! (2)

349 Success; Cooperation Plan! (2)

This was also the reason why Sun Luguo and Liu Yuhang often quarreled.

However, what was the situation now?

Ordinary people naturally did not know that the reason why such a thing happened was because of a young man—Lin Fan!

At this moment, a series of footsteps sounded not far away.

As the door to the private room was pushed open, a tall and handsome young man appeared in everyone’s field of vision.

It was Lin Fan!

“Brother Lin Fan!” Liu Yuhang and Sun Luguo shouted at the same time.

At the same time, Liu Sifang, Liu Yi, Sun An, Sun Qing Quan, and the others all stood up.

“Mr. Lin, welcome. Please take a seat.”

As for where he sat, Lin Fan did not have many requirements.

After all, no matter where he sat, they were just eating normally.

Therefore, he did not decline too much and directly sat in the main seat.

Liu Sifang said, “Mr. Lin, Yuhang often mentions you in front of us. You have superb driving skills and excellent chess skills. In just three days, you achieved a staggering 400% profit in a god-level operation in the stock market!”

As Liu Sifang said this, his wrinkled old face was filled with admiration.

After a while, he praised, “You’re indeed extraordinary after seeing you today!”

He was not exaggerating.

Ever since Lin Fan walked into the room, Liu Sifang had been observing him silently.

Ordinary young people would definitely feel uneasy in front of them.

However, Lin Fan remained calm and collected.

Just this temperament alone was not something ordinary people could compare to.

Sun An said, “I’m not very good at car racing or finance, but I like chess. Mr. Lin, how about we play a few rounds in the future?”

Lin Fan said, “Of course.”

“Alright, haha!” Sun An said happily.

Exquisite dishes were served by the waiters.

The general manager of the Imperial Hotel, Wang Fengyi, was holding a bottle of 2003 Lafite. Just as he was about to say something, he suddenly saw Lin Fan, who was sitting in the main seat. He could not help but say in surprise, “Mr. Lin!”

Lin Fan smiled and nodded at him.

For Wang Fengyi to become the general manager of the Imperial Hotel in Jiangbei… In other words, all the big shots and powers in Jiang Province had a certain level of understanding of the situation.

Among them, Sun Medical Company and Liu Medical Company were very important in Jiangbei and even the entire Jiang Province. Wang Fengyi naturally knew about them.

When he found out that Sun Medical Company and Liu Medical Company, which had always been opposing each other, had gathered together to treat someone to a meal, it really surprised Wang Fengyi.

However, after seeing Lin Fan, Wang Fengyi had a look of realization.

To Wang Fengyi, no matter how unbelievable it was, as long as it Lin Fan was involved, it was nothing.

He suddenly understood, but Sun An, Liu Sifang, and the others were somewhat puzzled.

The general manager of the Imperial Hotel seemed to be very familiar with Lin Fan?

“Manager Wang, you also know Mr. Lin?” Liu Sifang could not help but ask.

Wang Fengyi was a little hesitant about whether he should tell the truth.

That was because he did not know if Lin Fan wanted the people in the room to know his identity.

Lin Fan naturally understood Wang Fengyi’s concerns. He could not help but laugh. “I’m the owner of the Imperial Hotel.”

Hiss!

Everyone in the room gasped.

One had to know…

The Imperial Hotel was a landmark building in Jiangbei, and its overall cost was more than ten billion yuan.

He owned a billion-dollar hotel!

Lin Fan was just a young man in his 20s.

This… How incredible was this?

However, how could they have known that the Imperial Hotel was merely one of Lin Fan’s many businesses?

The Sun family and Liu family had only thought of Lin Fan as a genius researcher.

At this moment, they felt that Lin Fan was tall and mysterious.

As the dishes were placed on the table one after another, Liu Sifang raised his wine glass and said, “Today, I’m very happy to be able to invite Mr. Lin for a meal…

“I propose that we all raise our glasses to Mr. Lin.”

“To Mr. Lin!”

Everyone present raised their glasses and drank the wine in their glasses.

As the wine went down their throats, the atmosphere became even more intense.

“During this period of time, Luguo has grown a lot under your influence. Mr. Lin, thank you,” Sun An said.

After saying that, he raised his glass again.

Lin Fan smiled. “How did I affect anything? I’m friends with Sun Luguo and Liu Yuhang. Old Master, you don’t have to be so polite to me. You don’t have to call me Mr. Lin either. Just call me Lin Fan.”

“Alright, haha!” Sun An and Liu Sifang said happily.

…

In this banquet, Lin Fan was undoubtedly the main character. There were countless people toasting and chatting with him.

Finally, Liu Sifang felt that it was about time, so he told him the purpose of the banquet.

“Lin Fan, I heard from Yuhang and Luguo that you’ve developed a human islet recovery medicine and want to hand it over to Liu Medical Group and Sun Medical Group to sell?”

Everyone pricked up their ears when they heard this.

This matter… was of great importance to them.

If they could really become an agent, then Sun Medical Company and Liu Medical Company might become famous pharmaceutical companies in the country or even the world!

This was definitely an opportunity to reach the heavens in a single step!

Lin Fan said casually, “Yes.”

Instantly, everyone in the private room began to breathe rapidly.

It was true!

It was true!

“Then…” Sun An asked. “I wonder if you have a plan to act as an agent?”

Lin Fan said, “No… It’s too troublesome to prepare for that. Do you have a plan?”

This was the truth.

If he was not afraid of trouble, Lin Fan could have started his own pharmaceutical company to sell the medicine.

Sun An and Liu Sifang looked at each other.

After a while, Sun An said, “In fact, we have a preliminary plan. I’ll tell you about it first. If you’re not satisfied with anything, you can propose changes.”

“Alright,” said Lin Fan.

“Sun Medical Company and Liu Medical Company will provide the production plant for the human islet recovery medicine. We’ll also be in charge of the advertising, sales, and so on. We’ll take a total of 40% of the profits. Lin Fan, you don’t have to do anything and you can directly have 60% of the profits of the human islet recovery medicine…

“We will send you all the sales data regularly. You can check it at any time,” Sun An said.

There was no cost and no risk. 60% of the profits would be directly obtained from the technology. Overall, it was a very sincere plan.

Thus, Lin Fan said, “Sure.”

Originally, Liu Sifang and Sun An thought that Lin Fan would think for a long time after hearing the proposal.

Perhaps… He would even ask for a few more percentage points.

However, they did not expect Lin Fan to say yes so easily.

He agreed?

This… Did he not even think about it?

Sun An and Liu Sifang had experienced many things.

At this moment, however, they could not help but be stunned.

Sun An swallowed his saliva and said, “Lin… Lin Fan, you mean…”

“What you said just now is fine,” Lin Fan said.

In fact, Lin Fan knew that even if he asked for a few more points, it would not be a problem.

However, there was no need.

It was just a few points. Lin Fan did not take it to heart at all.

As long as he did not have to trouble himself, it was fine.

As for the finances, it did not matter even if the Sun and Liu families did not send the data and reports over.

Lin Fan had the super smart watch, Lil White. He could easily find out about the situation.

After getting Lin Fan’s confirmation, Sun An and Liu Sifang still felt that it was not real.

The human islet recovery medicine that was enough to make Sun Medical Company and Liu Medical Company soar to the sky was in this man’s hands.

Liu Yuhang said, “Brother Lin Fan, please don’t give the Liu and Sun families any benefits just because of me and Sun Luguo.”

“Yeah, Brother Lin Fan. There’s no need,” Sun Luguo followed.

Lin Fan smiled. “Don’t worry, I know what to do.”

“Thank you, Brother Lin Fan!” Sun Luguo and Liu Yuhang said sincerely.

They understood what kind of benefits Lin Fan had brought them.

Lin Fan smiled. “What are you thanking me for? It’s just a small matter!”

Suddenly, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! You’ve completed the hidden mission—brotherhood. You’ve received two golden packets.]

Lin Fan was stunned.

Brotherhood?

This… It should be Sun Luguo and Liu Yuhang.

In other words, not only could he obtain 60% of the profits of the human islet recovery medicine, but he even got two golden packets?

This banquet was not bad!
